purpose: Real-life reference viewpoints. Each one is rendered from the game (capture.cjs) and compared by eye with the street-level panorama at the same place (link only). No third-party imagery is stored or committed; findings are written as text in handoffs/fidelity/BACKLOG.md and game/research/.

fields.heading: compass bearing of the view, degrees (0 = north)
fields.surface: 'top' = stand on the highest road surface at that spot (a deck), 'ground' = the lowest
fields.eyeM: eye height above that surface (a street-view car camera is about 2.5 m)
fields.source: why this viewpoint exists (owner report id, landmark, verified reference)
